title: 21 不讲武德22 血如汞浆
content_zh:
“喝！”
贾彦勇大喝一声。
满脸横肉的面相，看起来给人一种凶神恶煞的感觉。
他脚下猛地一蹬，朝林哲羽冲了过去，挥动沙包大的拳头轰向林哲羽面门。
奔跑过程中，贾彦勇已经在头脑中浮现出一拳将林哲羽揍翻在地，吓得跪地求饶的模样。
林哲羽见状，似乎真吓住了。
他站在原地一动不动。
贾彦勇的速度极快，片刻间便来到了林哲羽的面前。
他的拳头挥舞起来，呼呼作响，朝着林哲羽的脑袋招呼过去，脑海中出现了林哲羽被一拳干翻在地的画面。
“嗯？”
没有感觉到拳头轰击在脸颊的触感，贾彦勇一拳打空了。
林哲羽腰部一扭，朝左边避开。
右手用力甩出，准备了许久的红色的粉末朝贾彦勇眼睛洒落而去。
粉末洒出，林哲羽快速退开，还是被辣椒粉刺激得咳嗽了几声。
这辣椒粉，他准备了大半个月，一直没机会用上。
还以为以后即便使用了，对象也不是贾彦勇，没想到今天贾彦勇自己撞上来了。
啊！
咳咳……啊……
贾彦勇感觉眼前一红，辛辣刺激的红色粉末糊了他一脸，眼睛顿时传来强烈的刺痛感。
惨叫声伴随着咳嗽声响彻在街道上。

“啊，我要杀了你，杀了你！”
贾彦勇大声怒吼。
他双目紧闭，眼泪直流，模糊了双眼。
火辣辣的感觉，伴随着剧烈的痛苦从眼睛传来，贾彦勇感觉眼睛仿佛要瞎了般，心中既愤怒又惊恐。
他不敢想象自己眼睛瞎了后的生活会变得怎么样。
他闭着眼，挥舞着拳头对着空气一阵乱击。
林哲羽一个猛冲，一记蛮牛冲撞，轰中贾彦勇胸膛，震得他后退了好几步。
不得不说，辣椒粉是真的好用。
这贾彦勇的实力很强，真要打起来，他不一定是对手。
一击得手，林哲羽再次欺身上前。
一套蛮牛拳使出，失去视野的贾彦勇挥着王八拳根本打不着林哲羽，被轻松打翻在地。
“看在你哥哥份上，饶你一命，下次就没这么好运了。”
“快去冲冲水吧，说不定眼睛还能保住。”
林哲羽看着眼流直流的贾彦勇说道。
周围聚集来的群众原来越多，他没有继续动手。
要不是这里是内城，路过的行人众多，林哲羽早就直接下狠手将这家伙干掉了。
从贾彦勇身旁绕过去，若无其事地朝家里走去。
……
月光如瀑，洒落院落。
content_en:
"Drink!"
Jia Yanyong shouted loudly.
The face is full of flesh, giving people a sinister look.
He kicked his feet violently, rushed towards Lin Zheyu, and swung his sandbag-sized fist towards Lin Zheyu's face.
While running, Jia Yanyong already had an image in his mind of knocking Lin Zheyu to the ground with one punch and kneeling down to beg for mercy in fear.
Lin Zheyu seemed really frightened when he saw this.
He stood motionless.
Jia Yanyong was extremely fast and arrived in front of Lin Zheyu in a moment.
He waved his fist, whirring, and greeted Lin Zheyu's head. The image of Lin Zheyu being knocked to the ground by a punch appeared in his mind.
"Huh?"
Not feeling the touch of the fist hitting his cheek, Jia Yanyong's punch missed.
Lin Zheyu twisted his waist and avoided it to the left.
He threw out his right hand hard, and the red powder that had been prepared for a long time fell towards Jia Yanyong's eyes.
The powder spilled out, and Lin Zheyu quickly backed away, but was still stimulated by the chili powder and coughed a few times.
He had been preparing this chili powder for more than half a month, but he never had a chance to use it.
I thought that even if I used it in the future, the target would not be Jia Yanyong, but I didn't expect that Jia Yanyong would bump into him today.
ah!
Ahem...ah...
Jia Yanyong felt his eyes turn red. The pungent red powder covered his face, and his eyes suddenly felt a strong stinging sensation.
Screams and coughs echoed through the streets.
"Ah, I'm going to kill you, kill you!"
Jia Yanyong roared loudly.
His eyes were closed tightly, tears streaming down his face, blurring his eyes.
A burning sensation, accompanied by severe pain, came from his eyes. Jia Yanyong felt as if his eyes were going blind, and he was both angry and frightened.
He couldn't imagine what his life would be like after he became blind.
He closed his eyes and punched the air with his fists.
Lin Zheyu rushed forward and hit Jia Yanyong in the chest with a bull charge, causing him to take several steps back.
I have to say, chili powder is really useful.
This Jia Yanyong is very strong. If we really want to fight, he may not be his opponent.
After succeeding with one blow, Lin Zheyu stepped forward again.
A set of wild bull punches was used. Jia Yanyong, who lost his vision, couldn't hit Lin Zheyu with his bastard punches and was easily knocked to the ground.
"For the sake of your brother, I'll spare your life. You won't be so lucky next time."
"Go and get some water. Maybe your eyes can be saved."
Lin Zheyu said looking at Jia Yanyong, whose eyes were watering.
As more and more people gathered around him, he did not continue to take action.
If it weren't for the fact that this was an inner city and there were so many pedestrians passing by, Lin Zheyu would have killed this guy directly.
He walked past Jia Yanyong and walked home as if nothing had happened.
…
The moonlight is like a waterfall, shining in the courtyard.
